stem: Thomas needs to add a sentence to the end of the second paragraph (sentences 5-9) to bring the paragraph to a more effective closing. Which of the following should be added after sentence 9 to help close this paragraph?

options.label: A
options.text: The basin is very different from anything I had seen before.

options.label: B
options.text: We knew it was wrong to leave trash in the basin.

options.label: C
options.text: The basin was a place that deserved to be saved.

options.label: D
options.text: I wanted to explore the basin the first time I saw it.
